prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Directly Before Desktop Waiting: Reorder sign-in to take place after adoption certificate confirmation and right before the desktop rendering phase. (why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in currently drops 23.1% of users.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Render & Overlay Diagnostic Check Flow: Introduce a desktop renderer diagnostic checklist step during waiting to verify system tray and window overlay compatibility. (why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to show on desktop, and home waiting mean time is 2336s.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Protection & Reset Prevention Copy: Update sign-in screen headline and hint to clarify that signing in protects existing pet data from being overwritten. (why: 8 support tickets mention pets missing or reset after signing in, causing drop-off.)
3: [home, hint] Taskbar Desktop Visibility Hint: Add a prominent hint during waiting stage describing where the pet lives in the system taskbar/menu bar. (why: 3 support emails report pets not showing up on desktop and users spending a median of 201s waiting.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Notification Alert: Enable desktop readiness push notifications and progress alerts so users know when generation completes. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, causing users to switch windows and miss pet spawn.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background Render Diagnostic Checklist Info: Add periodic diagnostic checklist updates on the waiting screen explaining step-by-step rendering progress. (why: High waiting time variance (median 201s vs mean 2336s) and complaints of missing desktop pets.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in directly addresses the 23.1% drop-off and 8 support emails regarding reset pets.
New diagnostic flow addresses high wait time and overlay issues, but requires new screens.
Simple copy fix for high drop-off step (23.1%) strongly backed by 8 support tickets.
Low-cost UI hint guiding users where to find the pet during the 201s median wait.
Notifications bring back users lost during the long 2336s mean waiting period.
Diagnostic updates reduce uncertainty for users waiting on home step.
